blindReview.limitation: Same-model reviewers can share correlated errors; this is not human review.

materialError.positiveWhen: At least one factual claim materially contradicts the supplied source evidence, invents unsupported project behavior, or omits a condition in a way that makes the answer misleading.
materialError.rate: answers with one or more material errors / all reviewed answers

coreFactCoverage.coveredWhen: Every required element of that composite fact is present and supported; partial mention does not count.
coreFactCoverage.rate: fully covered composite facts / all frozen composite facts

dimensions.definition: How directly the question serves the frozen interview objective.
How well it tests mechanisms and tradeoffs instead of recall alone.
How specifically the question is grounded in the frozen repository evidence.
How naturally follow-up questions deepen or qualify the primary question.

topicValue.mean: Arithmetic mean of all four dimension scores across reviewed question sets

labelStatus: not-materialized; this rubric does not contain fabricated sample labels
